name: Ninja Adventure (CC0 test kit)
notes: Every picture is the art desk's, read from the pinned desk commit by tools/desk-art.mjs (the pebbles and lily pads are the water bits, art/desk 3323aa85d).

map palette (art director, mibi-art f1a9fe54e, carried by 633e4d641): every map picture is the desk's recoloured copy in art-jobs/2026-11-10-art-recolour-map-palette/out/applied/<job>/. The pieces the desk has not re-issued there (the style test's route A rock, tufts and flowers, the hollow tree and split stone, the cliff re-cut sheets) take the desk's own colour map (tools/recolour.mjs, tools/recolour-palette.json = its out/palette.json), exact colour to exact colour, no pixel drawn; DESK.json says `recoloured`. The way-up pieces are the desk's own paint in the map palette (art/desk 1158b9710).

map decor, the walk's sprites (`desk`: true, tools/desk-art.mjs deskArt; the kit names stay and draw the signed pieces): every sprite is the art director's signed piece at its 1x size (one art pixel to one screen pixel, mibi-art 75f1ff195, art-jobs/2026-11-10-art-fix-decor-edges/out/p2/, manifest.json gives each size and foot), the files byte for byte, the foot the sprite's anchor. The tree is cut in two at the manifest's split row, the crown (the canopy) and the trunk with its ground shadow (the prop); tree-autumn draws the one signed tree, the three bushes share the round bush and the two boulder kit names draw the two small stones (the plain stone set, mibi-art art/art-fix-map-pieces 9c902c7ec, out/a2 and a2b: rock-a and rock-b 16 x 16 and stepped over, the stump 12 x 11; the boulders A 23 x 23, D 24 x 13 and E 24 x 18, each with a mirror; the generator's rocks are the three boulders and their mirrors, A blocks and D and E, under the explorer's shoulder, are stepped over), the flowers and tufts are the re-cut middle sizes (art/desk cc712a83e, art-recut-flowers-tufts-up p3: flowers 14 tall, tufts 10), every meadow plant also has a young and a grown size (art/desk cc712a83e, art-quiet-ground out/steps/; a mirror the desk has not made is the signed picture flipped, layout only) drawn by the meadow scatter as sc-<slot>[-young|-grown][-m], clump-tall is one of four signed tall clumps (each mirrored; the generator picks by hash), the sweeps of tall grass are the signed tufts-2 and tufts-3 as they are and mirrored. The grass flecks (six the art director keeps) are decals, the reed clumps (four shore looks, two water looks, each mirrored) are props that block nothing; both are laid by the generator's scatter rules (decor.mjs, reeds.mjs). The scrub ground takes one colour map.

terrain layers (`desk`: true, tools/desk-art.mjs deskLayers; set.json `layers` and `tone`): the water, earth, sand, mud, path and grass layers and the grass tone layer. A fill is slot 15 of a signed sheet cropped without a changed pixel (DESK.json `from: <sheet>#15`) or the desk's own fill strip. The water fill has four frames (the ripple job), each a strip of its four variants, 250 ms a frame; deep water stays still. Scrub is the olive flat ground over grass (its ground): the sheet, three variants and the slot-15 strip. Thicket and cliff come with every pixel of alpha under 255 made transparent in their over sheets (art director ruling 2026-11-09: the soft cast shade goes, the opaque undersides and face shading stay); the cliff sheets are the open-top cut (art director signed, mibi-art art/desk d85bcb82c, art-jobs/2026-11-11-art-recut-cliff-open: the lip and the face with the top transparent, so the ground of the raised tile shows; the way-ups are cut open the same way); the thicket fill is its full strip, the cliff fill is the signed raised meadow ground (fill-cliff), which the bake blanks on every raised tile that is no face; the old over-cliff sheets are retired (unsigned, they drew nowhere), the cliff has no sheet and its pieces are the signed back cells, the south faces and the way-ups. The tone layer is the signed lipless grass tone with its dark colour mapped to the sunlit step #82b266 (art director ruling 2026-11-09 20:4x: a patch is lighter than the grass, never a hollow); it is drawn on grass and on the raised top (the cliff terrain, where the cell two rows below is cliff too). The palette keeps its indices (palettePin) and the new colours follow.
